name: o-mods
description: Claude Code mods by omeerdvrn: sidebars, panes and hooks for everyday work.

plugins.name: heat
plugins.description: Quick prompts heat you up, and a pixel fire rises above the prompt.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Your Linear issues in a sidebar, with one click to start work.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Plan limits, git branch and cost, in a bar under the prompt.

plugins.name: usage-stats
plugins.description: Tokens, prompts and sessions on this machine, on one page.

plugins.name: persona
plugins.description: Pick a role, and Claude only edits what that role may touch.

plugins.name: pr-status
plugins.description: Your pull request's CI checks, live above the prompt.

plugins.name: themes
plugins.description: A new color theme in each session, so you can tell sessions apart.

plugins.name: scenes
plugins.description: Animated pixel scenes play above the prompt while Claude works.

plugins.name: huh
plugins.description: Opens Claude's last answer in a sidebar, rewritten to be easy to read.

plugins.name: snippets
plugins.description: Ticket suggestions, highlighting and text shortcuts in the input bar.

plugins.name: faah
plugins.description: Meme sounds when tests fail, tests pass, or Claude needs you.
